A [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] '''Jedi Master''' with pointed [[Ear/Legends|ears]] was among the founders of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], collectively known as the [[Four Masters/Legends|Four Masters]]. A monument in his or her effigy was placed at the main entrance of the Temple, but was destroyed millennia later following the start of [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]<ref name="Sabotage" /> around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4,000 years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. When the [[Jedi academy|Jedi enclave]] of [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] and its [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]] were [[Battle of Ossus (Great Sith War)|brought to the ground]]<ref name="SW:CL" /> by the [[Brotherhood of the Sith]],<ref name="TSW5">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 5]]</ref> that Jedi Master and three other colleagues were tasked with the construction of new headquarters for the Order. Together, the [[Four Masters/Legends|Four Masters]] established a new [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the site of the [[Sacred spire/Legends|Sacred Spire]], a natural peak located on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where earlier generations of Jedi had already erected small meditative chapels. The humanoid Master and his fellow founders were remembered through a series of four engraved pylons that ornated the formal entrance to their Temple.<ref name="SW:CL" /> Those statues, however, were either toppled or destroyed at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] during "[[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]]," when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] stormed the Temple with a detachment of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="ROS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
If their engraved effigy integrated into the Temple's façade was accurate, the Jedi Master belonged to [[Species/Legends|species]] of bulky, bald [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] with tapered [[Ear/Legends|ears]]. He or she sported long [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] with wide sleeves and a double collar, and wielded some sort of [[Polearm/Legends|pole]] weapon.<ref name="Sabotage" />

==Behind the scenes==
That Jedi Master's species remained unidentified.<ref name="Sabotage" /><ref name="SW:CL" /> However, that individual shared his pointed ears and bald head with the inhabitants of the [[Red Nebula/Legends|Red Nebula]] shown in [[Star Wars (1977) 50|''Star Wars'' (1977) 50]], the fiftieth issue in the [[Star Wars (1977)|''Marvel Star Wars'']] series of comics.<ref name="SW50">[[Star Wars (1977) 50|''Star Wars'' (1977) 50]]</ref> When clarification on the pointy-eared [[Valenthyne Farfalla]] was sought from [[Leland Chee]], keeper of the [[Holocron continuity database]], he shared his personal theory that "all pointy-eared species are either [[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]] or closely related to Sephi,"<ref name="TOS">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1395#16675997|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2007-06-08|time=6:48 AM}}</ref> a reference to a pointy-eared species from ''[[Jedi: Yoda]]'', published in [[2004]].<ref name="J:Y">''[[Jedi: Yoda]]''</ref> The original design of the Four Masters' bas-reliefs was done by [[Ryan Church]], Concept Design Supervisor for [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="AoSW3">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref>
